verdicts.reason: A actually rearranges for the taller canvas, but the yellow block is now a stray patch behind the middle of the headline instead of a column it sits on. The photo shrinks to a small strip with a hard edge, and the CTA box floats on its own. Under the headline the layout is mostly empty white. B just letterboxes the original, so huge empty white bands sit above and below and nothing is laid out for the new shape. A is less bad because it at least adapts.
